plain: Peter Levenda, a writer on secret and occult history, says that some cemeteries on the Indonesian island of Java hold a ritual of marriage and sex at the grave of a prince. He says he visited one of these cemeteries himself. He told the story on a podcast with host Jesse Michels as an example of living rituals that reach toward unseen powers.
